title: Best routine/habit app!
body:
A beautiful brain created this app. It’s clean, smooth, and seamlessly functional between phone and watch. Perfectly balanced between the powerful flexible features without complicating anything. 10/10

Here’s how I use it:
Long routine I set the moment I get up that flows me through my morning. Timed tasks like exercise are set, while flexible tasks are skippable once completed, with waiting periods until the appropriate times. (I actually have moments in my morning where I can pause and breathe!)

My skincare routine, changes nightly but so does my layout with different days customised with each step in order. It even auto starts at the right time. My skin’s never been clearer.

My weekly planning/archiving routine is now flawless. I never forget to check emails, lay out my weekly budget, or tick off that one small habit. It goes down to seconds for each task, and if tasks are on my phone, it’s also right there on my watch. What a godsend.

I also use it at work to time tasks because once completed, the statistics show how far off I was for each task. Unbelievably powerful data alongside my other health data metrics.

title: Unstable and glitchy
body:
The idea for this app is amazing, but the glitches, instability, and poor user experience are getting very frustrating. I want to love this app, but I’m only waiting for a competitor to make a better one so I can leave. 
- Older versions of routines have suddenly reappeared to override existing routines 
- Developers aren’t fluent in English, so it’s hard to communicate issues to them 
- When adding a habit to a routine, it doesn’t appear straight away; you have to go back to the routines list and then in again to see it appear 
- Dragging a habit in a routine only works to the top of the screen, then you have to scroll up and move it up in stages  
- Same for reordering a routine in the list of routines 
- Changes to routines sometimes aren’t saved at all 
- Apple Watch app frequently doesn’t sync well, and routines won’t run, skipping straight to the ‘Awesome!’ final message 
- Despite being in silent mode, a habit finishing will play a sound through AirPods and stop—not just pause, stop—whatever you’re listening to  
- Obvious features, like having the projected end time on the Apple Watch, are missing 
- Finishing a routine often isn’t logged by the app, so it doesn’t record streaks well; I have to use a separate app for that

title: This app changed my life🌟🤩💕
body:
I am a school student trying to make the most of my teenage years. 🌅👯‍♀️✨ Although I have been doing terribly at this goal. 😩When I get home from school I find myself ruminating about what I said to people that day. I think about what I could of said that was better or if I said something stupid and they will leave me and I will be lonely again. I soon doom-scroll on my phone trying to distract myself📱. Even if I notice what I’m doing I feel like it is too late to do anything productive. I end up doing nothing till dinner.  When I go to bed I hate myself so much that I can’t sleep 🛌.

The cycle continued till I found your wonderful app🍃🌳🍃✨.  When I get home I made a shortcut that starts a routine, when I arrive home 🏠. I do yoga, meditation and journaling. I do homework after wards and focus perfectly. 
Since then I have gotten ‘A’s on every assessment I’ve been assigned! 🌟 I am so proud of my self. Then I do hobbies such as basketball, drawing and crocheting.🧶 I feel so much happier, more energetic, full-filled and more positive in every aspect of my life. This app saved me from so many bad days and sleepless nights. I can’t thank you all enough!🌸🌟✨Bug fixes are needed though!🐞🐜🐛. When I tap on my profile to type my name it takes me out of app. This is very frustrating and I would really appreciate it if this was fixed.

This is random but my sister always judges me for using this app and says it is brain washing. So sometimes i stop using it because I’m scared of being judged. Is it weird to use an app like this? 

Ps I love the plant icon as the first iron that appears. Plants symbolise growth which I find very powerful and encouraging🤩🍃🌳🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🌳
 
Once again, thank you so much for creating this spectacular app😊💫🤩✨✨✨ you are doing great in your updates. It is improving so much!🌸 I wish you all the best😃. Love from Australia 🇦🇺💕💕💕💕💕

title: Easy routine app for neurodiverse people!!
body:
Routinery is a very convenient way to organise your day & is still very useful without the premium option unlike other routine apps I've tried!! 

Pros I've noticed: 
- Being able to change the order of your routine activities while you're completing them is very helpful.
- The voice notifications are a great feature to helps me complete my routine without having to look at my phone & helps me get ready faster.

Cons i've noticed: 
- The app is very blinding in the mornings when I'm still trying to wake up. I wish they would make a dark mode setting for the app. 
- The volume of the voice notifications are extremely loud some days & doesnt change when I change my volume settings like the app suggests.

Overall routinery is one of the best routine apps I've tried. I have used the app for more than 3 months (which says a lot) and haven't had to delete it straight away because the in-app purchases make it unusable!! I would appreciate them making a dark mode setting 💞

body:

Three things would make it a five star app for me:

- A single tap to start a routine. At the moment it is a couple of taps. I need routines in my life because I’m so easily distracted, so getting started quickly is essential. 
- Better Apple Watch synchronisation. At the moment it is in beta and quite flaky. 
- Being able to have some steps only show up on certain days (e.g. I only need to water plants twice a week)

It’s still the best routine app without those features but I feel it will be complete for me when it has them.

title: Going from chaos to order
body:
If you are someone who (like me):

1. Sees the necessity of routine
2. Kicks and screams and avoids stuff when it gets boring, and
3. Has tried every other time management program out there without success…

… this app could be the one for you!

It’s great for visual people. Specific, colourful icons make it fun and the clean design focuses your attention on what’s important.

It’s flexible. Skip, swap, delete and modify to your heart’s desire.

It will keep you on track. There’s a certain something about the timer that works so well where other things haven’t. It gets into your head and you can’t ignore it, even when you’ve skipped half of your routine and feel like chucking it in. You want to do better, and it helps you to, slowly but surely. 

I haven’t used all of the features yet, like the behavioural contexts or feedback, but it’s been worth every cent of the subscription price so far. Thank you, Developer! 

PS I have one suggestion… if it’s possible, a replica of the timer in the notification screen would be awesome 😊

title: One of the best routine apps out there
body: The free trial version is great, and honestly better than a lot of the more expensive habit tracking apps out there. I’m surprised this app isn’t more popular! A few features that I really would love to see: - An simpler, untimed option where you can just see the current task to be done and check off when you’ve completed it. Some people can find being on a timer distracting and stressful - An option to automatically change certain tasks in a routine depending on days of the week. For example, under an exercise task an option to automatically have “Running” on Mondays and “Weights” on Tuesdays etc. - A timer and icon visual for the watch app - A one time purchase option with subscriptions These features would make the app so much better, but it’s still the best routine app I’ve used!

title: A really nice app. 🌱
body: This app, Routinery, has a simple and modern style which makes the app easy to use and navigate around. 💙 They made daily routines WAY easier and have a lot of icons to personalise your habits too! Even though the membership gives you many more helpful applications to ease through your routine (good investment if you buy it), this app is completely still usable without the subscription too! In my opinion, this is one of the best apps to maintain healthy daily habits. :)
